incidents.what: At 3:16 pm the system bought 6 stocks, but a check afterwards found the model scores used could not be reproduced (they were about 1.3 points too high). To keep the results honest, all 6 trades were cancelled at their purchase price (no profit or loss), and new safety checks were added that block trading if this ever happens again.

GitHub started the scheduled runs about 7 hours late, so 8, 9 and 13 Oct entries were skipped and the 12 Oct run timed out. Runs now work at any hour and catch up missed days; 12 and 13 Oct were replayed at the closing price.
